verdict.rationale: Plaid documents that IDV can 'verify that global ID documents are authentic and valid' and lists ID document verification as a core capability, but the evidence pack contains no published breakdown of specific supported countries or document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) as a discoverable list. missing for 10: a published country/document-type coverage list, document-type breakdown, and any independent corroboration of coverage breadth.
